reason: I have written every bill in my register for years and I count the drawer myself every night, so I know exactly where every rupee is. Ten thousand upfront plus five hundred a month to make my staff type bills on their phones fixes a problem I don't have.
objection: If the phone dies, the internet goes, or a stylist fiddles the entry, my record is gone or wrong. My register can't crash, and I don't want my staff's billing living on their own phones.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run for a month in my own salon for free, side by side with my register, and catching a real leak in cash or cancelled bills that my register missed.
